name: 签到助手
description_zh: WorkBuddy加油站每日积分签到助手：每日签到定时提醒、本地打卡记录与断签保护，不模拟点击或逆向接口，最后那一下签到由用户自己在客户端手动完成。触发词：签到、领积分、buddy积分、签到助手、签到提醒、提醒我签到、打卡、断签了怎么办。
description_en: A reminder-only daily check-in assistant: scheduled reminders, local streak tracking, and missed-day protection. It never simulates clicks, reads credentials, or calls any platform API — the actual check-in is done by the user manually in the client.
